results.name: render_view_draw_with_mirror

results.name: camera_reflect_across_plane
results.evidence: Copies a 0x15-dword camera block, then either reflects the camera's basis vectors and position across a plane using a Householder-style reflection (dot with normal, subtract 2*dot*normal) or, in the param_1[4]!=0 branch, offsets the camera along its forward axis scaled by vector3d_cross_product_length and param_1[4]/[5] (portal-warp case).

results.name: render_camera_projection_zrange_push_pop_set
results.evidence: param_1==param_2==-1.0 saves the current projection Z terms to DAT_006b8d84.. ; ==0.0 restores them; otherwise computes classic D3D Z row terms -((n+f)/(f-n)) and (-2nf/(f-n)) from param_1/param_2 (near/far) and writes them into the projection matrix at offsets 0x16c/0x17c.
results.summary: Saves, restores, or recomputes the projection matrix's near/far depth-range terms, used to temporarily bias the depth range (e.g. to avoid z-fighting for overlays/decals).

results.name: render_viewport_compute_projection_offset
results.evidence: Computes an aspect ratio from viewport rect shorts at in_EAX+0x2c..0x3a and writes 4 derived offset/skew values into in_ECX[0..3], swapping and negating the last two components - consistent with computing an off-axis projection center offset for an asymmetric sub-viewport.

results.name: render_camera_compute_frustum_bounds
results.evidence: Uses fptan(fov*0.5) and the viewport rect aspect ratio to scale the l/r/t/b values from in_EDX into in_ECX, returning 1 when the resulting extents are ordered correctly and 0 (with a default [-1,1] box) otherwise; sibling of chimera__render_camera_build_frustum which consumes similar extents.
results.summary: Computes the asymmetric near-plane frustum extents (left/right/top/bottom) for a camera/viewport, validating the result.

results.name: render_camera_build_frustum
results.evidence: The 'chimera__' prefix is a leftover naming hint, not evidence of Chimera-specific behaviour: the body builds a full 6-plane view frustum from a camera transform (in_ECX) and viewport rect (in_EAX) via matrix4x3_inverse/matrix4x3_transform_point/matrix4x3_transform_plane and vector3d_normalize_with_length, storing results into the frustum struct pointed to by unaff_ESI; called from every per-viewport render path in this batch.
results.summary: Builds the camera's view frustum (basis vectors, inverse matrix, and clip planes) used for culling and projection this frame.

results.name: render_frustum_classify_point_side_planes
results.evidence: Tests a point (in_EDX) against 4 planes stored at in_ECX+0x78/0x88/0x98/0xa8, returning an OR of bit flags (2,8,4) for each plane the point is outside of - a classic Cohen-Sutherland-style frustum outcode test.
results.summary: Computes a 4-bit clip outcode for a point against the camera's side frustum planes.

results.name: render_frustum_test_bounding_box
results.evidence: Builds the 8 corners of an AABB (unaff_EDI min/max triples), computes an outcode per corner against the frustum planes at in_ECX+0x78..0xb4, ANDs/ORs them, and returns 0 (fully outside), 1 (intersecting, confirmed by pack.py's tail 'return 1;'), or 2 (fully inside) depending on param_1's extra near-plane sub-test.
results.summary: Classifies an axis-aligned bounding box against the camera frustum as fully outside, intersecting, or fully inside.

results.name: render_frustum_test_sphere
results.evidence: Tests a sphere/box (in_EDX center, param_1 radius margin) against 9 planes at in_ECX+0x78..0xd4 with <= param_1 comparisons, returning 0/1/2 similar to the sibling FUN_0050d5b0 bounding-box test but with a scalar margin instead of 8 explicit corners.
results.summary: Classifies a sphere (center + radius) against the camera frustum planes as outside, partially inside, or fully inside.

results.name: render_portal_compute_screen_area
results.evidence: Computes clipped-interval overlap between a rectangle's near/far extents (in_ECX[4]/[5]) and screen-space bounds derived from in_EDX+0x144..0x168, returning the resulting overlap area (float10) or 0 when the rect is fully outside - a portal/LOD visibility area metric.
results.summary: Computes the projected screen-space overlap area of a portal-like rectangle against the current view, used for portal culling/visibility weighting.

results.name: render_viewport_compute_clip_extents
results.evidence: Reads the same struct offsets (0x144/0x158/0x164/0x168) consumed by FUN_0050dac0/FUN_0050de30 and derives 4 floats representing +/-1-normalized left/right/top/bottom extents.
results.summary: Computes the normalized (-1..1) screen-space clip rectangle bounds for the current viewport/projection.

results.name: render_project_world_point_to_screen
results.evidence: Transforms a world point (in_EDX) through a projection-like struct at unaff_ESI+0x144.. into normalized [-1,1] coordinates with explicit NaN-aware comparisons, then converts to 640x480-based pixel coordinates offset by unaff_EDI+0x2c/0x2e, returning a success flag; used by the sky/lens-flare code path for occlusion testing.
results.summary: Projects a world-space point into normalized device coordinates and then screen pixel coordinates, returning whether it lies within the view.

results.name: contrail_render_by_object_type_mask
results.evidence: Iterates the object table via FUN_004d0630, looks up each object's type tag (stride-0x20 tag lookup through DAT_0087bc14) and tests its type-category bit against param_1, then for each of up to 4 marker slots with refcount>1 calls FUN_0050e090(object, type_tag, marker_index) - matches building contrail geometry per object marker; called from render_scene_draw right before the transparent pass with mask 0xfffffff3.
results.summary: Iterates live objects whose type matches a bitmask and builds contrail geometry for each of their active contrail attachment points.

results.name: contrail_compute_edge_fade_factor
results.evidence: Computes the absolute cosine of the angle between the contrail's normal (in_EAX) and the vector from the camera position (DAT_007c3114/18/1c) to the contrail point (in_ECX), optionally applies a gamma curve via FUN_004ccac0 when bit 0x40 of *param_1 is set, and inverts the result when unaff_SI==2 (matching the ContrailRenderType enum).
results.summary: Computes a view-angle-dependent fade/alpha factor for a contrail segment, used to soften the geometry seen edge-on or head-on.

results.name: contrail_geometry_build_segment
results.evidence: Switches on *(short*)(param_2+0x18) with cases 0/1/2/4, matching ContrailRenderType's vertical_orientation/horizontal_orientation/media_mapped/viewer_facing values from types/tags.h (case 4 does a vector3d_cross_product with the view vector, matching viewer_facing); locks vertex/index buffers via FUN_0051bd60/FUN_0051be40/FUN_00511e80, writes a quad's 4 corner/color/UV values, and packs alpha via FUN_0050e000 and color_pack_argb_from_real.
results.summary: Builds the billboard quad geometry (position, UV, color) for one segment of a contrail, orienting it according to the contrail's render type.

results.name: object_shadows_update
results.evidence: Toggles device render-state flags DAT_0069c74c/DAT_0071d1fa around a call to FUN_0050eac0 (rebuild candidate list), then loops DAT_006b8dc0 times calling FUN_0050eba0 which computes a luminance-based darkening factor (0.299/0.587/0.114 weights) and distance thresholds typical of a fake blob-shadow system.
results.summary: Per-frame update of the fake object 'blob' shadow system: rebuilds the nearby-object list and applies each shadow to nearby BSP surfaces.

results.name: render_get_cluster_ambient_light_sample
results.evidence: Looks up a cached ambient-light sample via FUN_0050f150 and returns a pointer into the per-cluster cache table when found, otherwise falls back to object_sample_ambient_lighting/FUN_004f2430 writing into the global DAT_006b91c8 sample.
results.summary: Returns a pointer to the (cached or freshly-sampled) ambient lighting values for the current cluster/object.

results.name: render_object_cluster_matches_camera
results.evidence: Compares an object's resolved cluster (via a tag-table lookup chain through DAT_0087a478/DAT_0087a480) against unaff_ESI, falling back to a media-cluster check against DAT_006869d0/DAT_006869d2/DAT_00686a04 when the first test fails or FUN_00445ac0 returns 0.
results.summary: Tests whether a given cluster matches the camera's current cluster or media cluster, used to skip shadow/contrail work outside the camera's area.

results.name: object_shadows_rebuild_list
results.evidence: Increments a rebuild counter DAT_008603cc, sets a 'rebuilding' flag at DAT_006b8cbc+1, and calls FUN_00554420 twice (a callback-driven spatial query, taking function-pointer pairs including object_disconnect_from_map) to refill DAT_006b8dc4[0x100] with up to 256 candidate handles, tracking the count in DAT_006b8dc0 and an overflow flag DAT_0071cfbe.
results.summary: Rebuilds the cached list of up to 256 nearby objects/surfaces that are candidates for the fake shadow system this frame.

results.name: object_shadows_apply_all
results.evidence: Iterates DAT_006b8dc0 entries of DAT_006b8dc4, copying each handle into *in_EAX and calling FUN_0050eba0 for it - a simple driver loop over the list built by FUN_0050eac0.
results.summary: Applies the fake shadow effect for every candidate object/surface in the current shadow candidate list.

results.name: object_shadow_apply_single
results.evidence: Branches on unaff_EDI[2] between an object-shadow path (distance/flag checks then a 30.0-unit distance threshold and 1.0-luminance(0.299/0.587/0.114) darkness threshold of 0.19, feeding a smoothstep-like blend into FUN_0050f830) and a surface-shadow path using object flags 0x40000/1 and DAT_007c3310 dot-product tests, both ending in a call to FUN_0050ee20.
results.summary: Computes the shadow intensity/basis for one object or surface and applies it, skipping objects that are too far, too dark already, or otherwise excluded.

results.name: object_shadow_apply_to_surfaces
results.evidence: Recurses over a linked list of BSP surfaces (via puVar2[0x46]) applying a shadow/light blend through FUN_004d6fc0 with tangent-space data taken from puVar2+0x60/0x6e/0x4d, and conditionally calling FUN_004ffca0 and itself again for the linked surface, matching the pattern used by the shadow system's per-surface projection.

results.name: shadow_cache_get_or_allocate_entry
results.evidence: Looks for an existing cache slot for param_1 keyed by a back-reference check, otherwise allocates a new one via datum_new, evicting the entry with the largest DAT_007c3104-relative age when the pool is full, then calls FUN_0050f270 to (re)initialize it.
results.summary: Finds or allocates a per-object cached ambient/shadow sample entry, evicting the oldest entry when the cache is full.

results.name: shadow_cache_entry_update
results.evidence: Recomputes/refreshes a cache entry's ambient sample (object_sample_ambient_lighting, FUN_004f2430) when its distance/time-since-update exceeds thresholds derived from param_3, otherwise smoothly blends the previous sample toward the new one using FUN_0050f520/FUN_0050f5c0/FUN_0050f690/FUN_0050f690.
results.summary: Refreshes or smoothly interpolates a cached ambient-light/shadow sample entry based on how stale or far it is.

results.name: vector3_step_towards_clamped
results.evidence: For 3 float components, clamps (target-current) to +/-param_1 and adds it to current - a generic 'move value toward target by at most param_1' smoothing primitive, called from FUN_0050f270 with small constants (~0.03) to damp ambient-light changes over frames.
results.summary: Steps a 3-component value toward a target value, clamped to a maximum per-call delta (used to smooth cached lighting samples).

results.name: vector4_step_towards_clamped
results.evidence: Identical clamped-step pattern to FUN_0050f520 but operating on 4 float components.
results.summary: Steps a 4-component value toward a target value, clamped to a maximum per-call delta.

results.name: vector3_step_towards_clamped_and_normalize
results.evidence: Same clamped-step pattern as FUN_0050f520 but calls vector3d_normalize_with_length on the result afterward, consistent with smoothing a direction vector rather than a plain value.
results.summary: Steps a 3-component direction toward a target, clamped to a maximum delta, then re-normalizes it.

results.name: shadow_compute_falloff_radius
results.evidence: Reads an object radius (iVar1+0xac), scales it by the detail-level setting DAT_00689450 (1=half, 0=quarter, else full), divides by a distance-derived denominator built from the camera-space forward dot products (_DAT_007c3184/90/9c/a8), and doubles the result - a classic screen-space radius/falloff computation.
results.summary: Computes a distance- and detail-setting-scaled falloff radius used to size a shadow or ambient light projection.

results.name: shadow_build_projection_basis
results.evidence: Reads a forward direction from the object's tag data (iVar1+0xa0..0xac), builds a perpendicular basis via vector3d_build_perpendicular/vector3d_normalize_with_length, copies it via FUN_004cb970, and stores a related transform via FUN_00530ff0.
results.summary: Builds an orthonormal projection basis (tangent frame) for a shadow/light source from its stored forward direction.

results.name: shadow_compute_bounding_box_and_register
results.evidence: Expands the light/shadow's center (in_ECX+0x28) and radius (in_ECX+0x40) along its 3 basis axes (in_ECX+0x10/0x1c/0x28/0x34/0x38/0x3c) into a padded AABB and passes it to FUN_00552b40 for spatial registration; also one-shot-triggers FUN_0052ccc0 the first time a debug/graphics-mode combination is active this frame.
results.summary: Computes an axis-aligned bounding box around a shadow/light's basis and radius and registers it for spatial culling.

results.name: render_camera_media_cluster_matches
results.evidence: Checks a local-viewer condition via FUN_00445ac0, then for the in_AX marker/cluster index walks a tag-table chain (DAT_0087a478/DAT_0087a480/DAT_008603b0) to test bit 3 of a per-marker byte flag, matching the 'points pinned to media' style checks used by the contrail code.
results.summary: Tests whether the camera's current position/cluster matches the media cluster referenced by a marker, used to gate media-pinned contrail/shadow effects.

results.name: render_window_call_hook_weather_particle_systems_render
results.evidence: Existing non-FUN_ name kept from a prior session; the current decompilation is a single 'return;' with no code, so the name cannot be confirmed or refuted from this body alone - likely a stubbed-out/disabled render hook.
results.summary: Empty stub (immediate return) that appears to be a disabled hook point for rendering weather/particle systems.

results.name: contrail_render_all_active
results.evidence: Iterates all live objects via FUN_004d0630, filters by a per-object contrail-definition bitmask against DAT_007c3350, sorts the filtered point list with FUN_00510410 (introsort), groups consecutive duplicate keys, then for each group iterates its points calling FUN_00511700 to draw a quad and finally FUN_00511620 to flush the contrail instance, deleting stale points via datum_delete.
results.summary: Per-frame driver for the contrail system: gathers active contrail points across all objects, sorts/groups them, computes fade and builds geometry, and flushes each contrail instance for drawing.

results.name: sort_introsort_loop
results.evidence: Classic introsort driver: switches to FUN_00510830 (insertion sort) for small ranges (<=0x20/8-byte elements), to a heap-based fallback (FUN_00510980/FUN_005107e0) when the recursion-depth budget param_3 is exhausted, otherwise partitions via FUN_00510500 and recurses on the smaller half while looping on the larger - the standard MSVC STL std::sort implementation pattern.
results.summary: Generic introsort (quicksort/heapsort/insertion-sort hybrid) driver over 8-byte records, used here to sort the contrail point list.

results.name: sort_partition_median3
results.evidence: Selects a pivot at the midpoint, calls FUN_005108f0 (median-of-3/9 pivot selection) on the tail, then performs a Hoare-style partition scanning from both ends and swapping out-of-order 8-byte records, returning the split point pair - the classic std::sort partition helper.
results.summary: Partitions a range of 8-byte records around a median-of-three pivot as part of the introsort algorithm.

results.name: sort_heap_extract_to_end
results.evidence: Walks the range from the back, swapping the front element with each tail element and calling FUN_00510a90 (heap sift-down) after each swap - the pop_heap-driven sort phase of an introsort/heapsort fallback.
results.summary: Repeatedly pops the heap's maximum element into the tail of the range, part of the heapsort fallback path.

results.name: sort_insertion_sort
results.evidence: For each element beyond the first, compares against param_1 (or, in the else branch, binary/linear-searches backward) and calls FUN_00510ba0 (rotate) to insert it in place - a textbook insertion sort over 8-byte records used for small ranges by FUN_00510410.
results.summary: Insertion-sorts a small range of 8-byte records in place.

results.name: sort_median_pivot_select
results.evidence: Chooses between calling FUN_005109d0 (3-element median helper) once for small ranges or four times for large ranges (>0x28 elements) - the median-of-9 pivot selection used by std::sort's partition routine.
results.summary: Selects a good pivot for quicksort partitioning by sampling and median-sorting a handful of elements.

results.name: sort_make_heap
results.evidence: Iterates backward through the range calling FUN_00510a90 (sift-down) on each internal node - the classic bottom-up make_heap routine.
results.summary: Builds a max-heap in place over a range of 8-byte records.

results.name: sort_median3_swap
results.evidence: Performs the 3 pairwise compare-and-swaps of in_EAX/in_ECX/in_EDX by key (two shorts + a byte) that sort exactly 3 elements into order - the inner helper used by FUN_005108f0's median selection.
results.summary: Sorts 3 records into ascending order by comparing their (short,short,byte) key, used for median-of-N pivot selection.

results.name: sort_heap_sift_down
results.evidence: Classic sift-down/pop_heap_hole loop comparing children at in_EAX*2+1/+2 by key and moving the larger child up, then calls FUN_00510b20 (heap push) to finish placing the saved element - the standard STL __pop_heap/__adjust_heap pattern.
results.summary: Restores the max-heap property by sifting a hole down to a leaf and reinserting the saved element.

results.name: sort_heap_push
results.evidence: Walks up the heap from in_EAX comparing against parent nodes at (in_EAX-1)/2 and shifting them down until the correct slot for param_2/param_3 is found - the STL __push_heap pattern, called by FUN_00510a90 to finish a sift-down.
results.summary: Inserts a saved heap element at the correct position by walking up toward the root, part of the heap sift-down/push operation.

results.name: sort_rotate_range
results.evidence: Computes gcd(iVar8,iVar11) of two range lengths and performs the classic juggling/rotate-by-gcd algorithm (std::rotate) over 8-byte records between param_1 and unaff_EBX, used by FUN_00510830's insertion sort to shift an element into place.
results.summary: Rotates a range of 8-byte records in place (std::rotate-style), used to insert an out-of-order element during insertion sort.

results.name: sky_render_lights_and_lens_flares
results.evidence: Looks up the current cluster's Sky tag data and iterates a 0x74-byte-stride array matching the SkyLight struct in types/tags.h exactly (lens_flare_marker_name at +0x10..0x30, direction Euler2D at +0x68/+0x6c): when the marker name is empty it converts the stored yaw/pitch (fcos/fsin of offsets 0x6c/0x68) into a direction vector, otherwise it looks up the named marker's world position via FUN_004d7850; it then normalizes the direction, builds a perpendicular basis via vector3d_build_perpendicular, and calls FUN_004f1600 with the resulting position/direction/up vectors.
results.summary: Iterates the current sky's SkyLight entries, resolves each one's direction (fixed angle or a named marker), and renders its associated lens flare.

results.name: render_light_transform_point_and_normal
results.evidence: When bit 0 of *(byte*)(param_1+0x10) is clear, transforms a point/normal pair through DAT_007c3178 via matrix4x3_transform_point/matrix4x3_transform_normal unless param_2 bit 0 selects a fast copy-through path.

results.summary: Builds a 2- or 3-axis orientation basis for a billboard quad based on a render-type selector.

results.name: render_billboard_compute_length_scale
results.evidence: For param_1==0 with an uninitialized *in_ECX, derives a scale from -(param_2's depth field)/_DAT_007c32ec, otherwise multiplies *in_ECX by the marker-count field at param_3+4 - producing the length/width scale used by FUN_00511700's quad extents.
results.summary: Computes a length/width scale factor for a billboard segment based on its marker count or projected depth.

results.evidence: Computes the absolute normalized dot product of in_EAX and in_ECX (an alignment/view-angle cosine) and inverts it when param_1==2, mirroring FUN_0050e000's contrail fade computation but operating on raw vectors already in register.
results.summary: Computes a view/normal alignment fade factor (0..1) for a billboard segment, inverted for a particular render-type selector.

results.name: render_billboard_system_frame_init
results.evidence: Resets the per-frame occlusion accumulators DAT_007c30c4/DAT_007c30c8 to 0, then transforms the camera-local axis vectors at PTR_DAT_00696720/PTR_DAT_0069671c through the camera's rotation rows (DAT_007c317c../0x3198/0x319c) into world-space basis pairs stored at DAT_007c30d0.. and DAT_007c30dc..
results.summary: Per-frame initialization for the billboard/lens-flare system: resets occlusion accumulators and computes world-space camera axis vectors.

results.name: render_billboard_group_get_or_create_buffer
results.evidence: Searches an 8-slot table at unaff_EDI+0x24 (stride 0x10) for an entry matching in_EAX (a shader/bitmap handle), and if not found and there is room, allocates a new vertex buffer via FUN_00444550/FUN_0051bdd0/FUN_0051be40, tracking a failure flag DAT_0071cfbf; returns the slot index or -1.
results.summary: Finds or allocates a vertex-buffer slot for a given shader/material group used to batch billboard quad geometry.

results.name: contrail_instance_draw
results.evidence: Averages the per-point width sample into *(float*)(unaff_ESI+0x14/0x18/0x1c), transforms the result via matrix4x3_transform_point into DAT_007c31ac, and for each of up to 8 recorded material groups either invokes a shader vtable call (**+0x30) or flushes buffered geometry via FUN_0051c830.
results.summary: Finalizes and submits a contrail instance's accumulated billboard geometry for drawing, grouped by shader/material.

results.name: render_billboard_quad_build
results.evidence: Looks up a shader-group vertex slot via FUN_00511520, builds an oriented basis via FUN_00511190/FUN_005111f0/FUN_00511330 (optionally combined with a rotation angle via fsin/fcos of param_4), packs the color via color_pack_argb_from_real, writes 4 corner vertices with UVs and color into the locked buffer while tracking a running bounding box, and updates an occlusion-area accumulator via FUN_0050dac0.
results.summary: Builds and writes one oriented, colored billboard quad (used by both the contrail and lens-flare systems) into the appropriate shader-group vertex buffer.

results.name: contrail_draw_segment_blended
results.evidence: Computes the angle between two vectors via vector3d_angle_between_4cd4f0 and a squared deviation from perpendicular (angle-pi/2)^2*0.4052847 clamped to [0,1] as a blend factor, then draws one quad with orientation literal 1 (matching contrailrendertype_horizontal_orientation) or 3 (contrailrendertype_ground_mapped) scaled by that factor via FUN_00511700, and a second, edge-on quad scaled by the remainder via fpatan/FUN_00628cca.
results.summary: Draws a contrail segment as a blend of a flat, ground/horizontal-oriented quad and a viewer-edge-on quad, weighted by the view angle, to avoid the quad disappearing when viewed edge-on.

results.name: render_device_is_ready
results.evidence: Returns 1 only when both DAT_0071d16c (a ready/initialized flag) and DAT_0071d174 (the Direct3D device pointer) are non-zero, otherwise 0 - a simple renderer-initialized guard.
results.summary: Returns whether the renderer/Direct3D device has been initialized and is ready for use.

results.name: rasterizer_device_reinitialize_and_update_checksum
results.evidence: Advances a running offset DAT_006e2dcc by 0x10, feeds a 4-byte constant into crc32_update(&DAT_006e2dd4, ...), stores the new offset to DAT_0071cfc0, and calls rasterizer_initialize_direct3d().
results.summary: Updates an internal running checksum/offset and reinitializes the Direct3D rasterizer device.
